Default questions shown by every FAQ that has no questions of its own.

settings.label: Question 1
settings.default: What is this tank made of?

settings.label: Answer 1
settings.default: 80% premium Nylon, 20% Spandex. We tested dozens of fabric blends to find the exact ratio that gives you enough stretch and hold without feeling tight or suffocating. It's soft against the skin, breathes well, and holds its shape after repeated washing.

settings.label: Question 2
settings.default: Will the padding shift or fall out like other built-in bras?

settings.label: Answer 2
settings.default: No. The padding stays in place while you wear it, it won't move around or bunch up. When you want to take it out, it comes out easily. Put it back in and it stays put, every single time.

settings.label: Question 3
settings.default: Will this work for my body type? I have a larger chest.

settings.label: Answer 3
settings.default: The tank is designed to accommodate a wide range of body types and bust sizes. The distributed support structure means the hold comes from the entire garment, not just a narrow band - so there’s no single point bearing all the weight.

settings.label: Question 4
settings.default: Can I really wear this instead of a bra?

settings.label: Answer 4
settings.default: That's exactly what it's designed for. Most of our customers wear it as their complete bra replacement for everyday activities: errands, school pickup, work, brunch, WFH, travel, lounging. It provides 'supported enough' comfort for daily life.

settings.label: Question 5
settings.default: Will this show through white or light-coloured clothing?

settings.label: Answer 5
settings.default: The tank is designed with layering in mind. In neutral colours, it sits discreetly under light tops. For sheer or very thin white fabric, we recommend choosing a shade that’s close to your skin tone.

settings.label: Answer 6
settings.default: Machine wash on a gentle cycle, cold water. Lay flat to dry or tumble dry on low. The fabric and padding are engineered to hold their shape and support through repeated washes. No special care required.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: Here's Why Bras Stopped Working For You

settings.label: Lead
settings.default: It's not your body. It's the design.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Traditional bras force all their support into three pressure zones: two straps and a band. That's it. Every gram of hold your body needs gets concentrated into those three narrow points.

settings.label: Bold closing text
settings.default: And because the support is concentrated, not distributed, those pressure points only get worse as the day goes on.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: And Here's Why Nothing Else Has Worked Either

settings.label: Item 1 text
settings.default: Soft? Yes. Supportive? Barely. They feel lovely in the store, but under a real top, there's nothing there. No smoothing. No coverage.

settings.label: Item 2 text
settings.default: The elastic gives up after three washes. They roll up at the waist. The built-in 'bra' is a thin strip of fabric that flattens instead of supports.

settings.label: Item 3 text
settings.default: Designed for an hour at the gym, not twelve hours of living. Too tight. Too compressive. A nightmare to get on and off.

settings.label: Item 4 text
settings.default: Better than underwire, but they still use the same architecture: a band, two straps, and concentrated pressure.

settings.label: Closing quote
settings.default: The problem isn't that you haven't found the right bra.The problem is that you keep looking for the answer inside the same category that created the discomfort.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: What We Changed - And Why It Feels Different

settings.label: Subheading
settings.default: We didn't build a better bra. We stopped building bras entirely.

settings.label: Box text
settings.default: Instead of forcing support into two straps and a band, we spread it across the entire tank. No concentrated pressure points. No hardware. No architecture that digs, pinches, or rolls.

settings.label: Box italic text
settings.default: This isn't shapewear. This isn't compression. This is "supported enough" - the feeling of being gently held and smoothly covered, without a single part of the tank fighting against your body.

settings.label: Layers heading
settings.default: How It Works - Layer By Layer

settings.label: Layer 1 text
settings.default: The inner layer provides gentle, even hold across the entire torso. No narrow bands concentrating pressure.

settings.label: Layer 2 text
settings.default: The padding feels soft against your skin. The support underneath still holds a full D+.

settings.label: Layer 3 text
settings.default: No underwire. No hooks. Wide shoulder coverage distributes weight evenly so nothing digs into your shoulders.

settings.label: Layer 4 text
settings.default: The outer layer sits flat against your body and creates a clean silhouette under clothes. Just a smooth, polished look.

settings.label: Step 1 text
settings.default: No clasps. No hooks. No fumbling behind your back. Just pull it over your head like any tank top.

settings.label: Step 2 text
settings.default: You're smooth. You're covered. You're supported. Grab your keys and go.

settings.label: Step 3 text
settings.default: No mid-morning strap adjustment. No post-lunch band tug. Just comfort that lasts from coffee to couch.
